40022571.author: पदार्थः
40022571.content: एतत् this, आख्याय having narrated, रामाय to Rama, महर्षिः the great sage, कुम्भसम्भवः Agastya, अस्याम् in this, एव indeed, अपरम् another, वाक्यम् statement, कथायाम् in the story, उपचक्रमे began.

40022571.author: Translation
40022571.content: Having narrated this to Rama, the great sage Agastya then began another part of the same story.

40022572.author: पदार्थः
40022572.content: ततः then, सः he, दण्डः Danda, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, बहुवर्षगणायुतम् for many thousands of years, अकरोत् ruled, तत्र there, दान्तात्मा with a controlled self, राज्यम् the kingdom, निहतकण्टकम् free from enemies.

40022572.author: Translation
40022572.content: O Kakutstha, then King Danda, with a controlled mind, ruled his kingdom there, free from enemies, for many thousands of years.

40022573.author: पदार्थः
40022573.content: अथ then, काले at a time, तु indeed, कस्मिंश्चित् some, राजा the king, भार्गवम् of Bhrigu, आश्रमम् the hermitage, रमणीयम् delightful, उपाक्रामत् approached, चैत्रे in Chaitra, मासि in the month, मनोरमे charming.

40022573.author: Translation
40022573.content: Then, at some point, the king approached the delightful hermitage of Bhrigu in the charming month of Chaitra.

40022574.author: पदार्थः
40022574.content: तत्र there, भार्गवकन्याम् the daughter of Bhrigu, सः he, रूपेण in beauty, अप्रतिमाम् unequalled, भुवि on earth, विचरन्तीम् wandering, वनोद्देशे in the forest region, दण्डः Danda, अपश्यत् saw, अनुत्तमाम् unsurpassed.

40022574.author: Translation
40022574.content: There, King Danda saw the unsurpassed daughter of Bhrigu, unequalled in beauty on earth, wandering in the forest region.

40022575.author: पदार्थः
40022575.content: सः he, दृष्ट्वा having seen, ताम् her, सुदुर्मेधाः very foolish, अनङ्गशरपीडितः afflicted by the arrows of Kama, अभिगम्य having approached, सुसंविग्नाम् very agitated, कन्याम् the maiden, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40022575.author: Translation
40022575.content: Having seen her, the very foolish king, afflicted by the arrows of Kama, approached the very agitated maiden and spoke words to her.

40022576.author: पदार्थः
40022576.content: कुतः whence, त्वम् you, असि are, सुश्रोणि O beautiful-hipped one, कस्य whose, वा or, असि are, सुता daughter, शुभे O auspicious one, पीडितः afflicted, अहम् I, अनङ्गेन by Ananga, गच्छामि I approach, त्वाम् you, शुभानने O beautiful-faced one.

40022576.author: Translation
40022576.content: O beautiful-hipped one, from where are you, or whose daughter are you, O auspicious one; I am tormented by Cupid, and so I approach you, O beautiful-faced one.

40022577.author: पदार्थः
40022577.content: तस्य to him, तु indeed, एवम् thus, ब्रुवाणस्य speaking, मोहोन्मत्तस्य maddened by delusion, कामिनः lustful, भार्गवी the daughter of Bhrigu, प्रत्युवाच replied, इदम् this, वचः word, सानुनयम् with humility, नृपम् to the king.

40022577.author: Translation
40022577.content: To that lustful king, who was speaking thus, maddened by infatuation, the daughter of Bhrigu replied with these humble words.

40022578.author: पदार्थः
40022578.content: भार्गवस्य of Bhrigu, सुताम् daughter, विद्धि know, देवस्य of the divine one, अक्लिष्टकर्मणः of unwearied deeds, अरजाम् Araja, नाम named, राजेन्द्र O king of kings, ज्येष्ठाम् the eldest, आश्रमवासिनीम् dwelling in the hermitage.

40022578.author: Translation
40022578.content: O king of kings, know me to be Araja by name, the eldest daughter of the divine sage Bhrigu, whose deeds are pure, and who dwells in the hermitage.

40022579.author: पदार्थः
40022579.content: मा do not, माम् me, स्पृश touch, बलात् by force, राजन् O king, कन्या a maiden, पितृवशा dependent on her father, हि indeed, अहम् I, गुरुः teacher, पिता father, मे my, राजेन्द्र O king of kings, त्वम् you, च and, शिष्यः disciple, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, व्यसनम् calamity, सुमहत् very great, क्रुद्धः enraged, सः he, ते to you, दद्यात् would give, महातपाः of great penance.

40022579.author: Translation
40022579.content: O king, do not touch me by force, for I am a maiden dependent on my father; O king of kings, my father is your preceptor, and you are the disciple of that great-souled one, and if enraged, that sage of great penance would inflict a very great calamity upon you.

40022580.author: पदार्थः
40022580.content: यदि if, वा or, अन्यत् anything else, मया by me, कार्यम् to be done, धर्मदृष्टेन according to dharma, सत्पथा by the righteous path, वरयस्व ask for, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, पितरम् father, मे my, महाद्युतिम् highly effulgent.

40022580.author: Translation
40022580.content: O best among men, if anything else is to be done by me according to the righteous path of dharma, then ask for me from my glorious father.

40022581.author: पदार्थः
40022581.content: अन्यथा otherwise, तु indeed, फलम् consequence, तुभ्यम् for you, भवेत् would be, घोराभिसंहितम् terrible, क्रोधेन by anger, हि indeed, पिता father, मे my, असौ he, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, अपि even, निर्दहेत् would burn completely.

40022581.author: Translation
40022581.content: Otherwise, the consequence for you would be terrible, for my father, in his anger, could indeed burn down even the three worlds.

40022582.author: पदार्थः
40022582.content: दास्यते will give, च and, अनवद्याङ्ग O one with faultless limbs, तव to you, मा me, याचितः when requested, पिता father.

40022582.author: Translation
40022582.content: And O one with faultless limbs, my father will give me to you when he is requested.

40022583.author: पदार्थः
40022583.content: एवम् thus, ब्रुवाणाम् to the speaking, अरजाम् to Araja, दण्डः Danda, कामवशम् under the sway of desire, गतः having gone, प्रत्युवाच replied, मदोन्मत्तः intoxicated with passion, शिरसि on the head, आधाय having placed, च and, अञ्जलिम् folded hands.

40022583.author: Translation
40022583.content: Having thus gone under the sway of desire, Danda, intoxicated with passion, replied to Araja, placing his folded hands on his head.

40022584.author: पदार्थः
40022584.content: प्रसादम् favor, कुरु do, सुश्रोणि O one with beautiful hips, न not, कालम् time, क्षेप्तुम् to waste, अर्हसि you ought, त्वत्कृते for your sake, हि indeed, मम my, प्राणाः life breaths, विदीर्यन्ते are being torn apart, वरानने O one with a beautiful face.

40022584.author: Translation
40022584.content: O one with beautiful hips and a beautiful face, please grant me your favor; you should not waste time, for indeed, my life breaths are being torn apart for your sake.

40022585.author: पदार्थः
40022585.content: त्वाम् you, प्राप्य having obtained, मे my, वधः death, वा or, स्यात् may be, शापः curse, वा or, यदि if, दारुणः terrible, भक्तम् devoted, भजस्व accept, माम् me, भीरु O timid one, भजमानम् serving, सुविह्वलम् greatly agitated.

40022585.author: Translation
40022585.content: O timid one, even if I obtain you and face death or a terrible curse, please accept me, your devoted servant who is greatly agitated.

40022586.author: पदार्थः
40022586.content: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, तु indeed, ताम् her, कन्याम् maiden, दोर्भ्याम् with two arms, गृह्य having seized, बलात् by force, बली the strong one, विस्फुरन्तीम् struggling, यथाकामम् as he desired, मैथुनाय for sexual intercourse, उपचक्रमे he began.

40022586.author: Translation
40022586.content: Having spoken thus, the powerful Daṇḍa seized the struggling maiden with his arms by force and proceeded to have sexual intercourse with her as he desired.

40022587.author: पदार्थः
40022587.content: एतम् this, अर्थम् deed, महाघोरम् very terrible, दण्डः Daṇḍa, कृत्वा having committed, सुदारुणम् very cruel, नगरम् to the city, प्रययाव he went, आशु quickly, मधुमन्तम् Madhumanta, अनुत्तमम् unequalled.

40022587.author: Translation
40022587.content: Having committed this extremely dreadful and very cruel act, Daṇḍa quickly departed to his unequalled city of Madhumanta.

40022588.author: पदार्थः
40022588.content: अरजा Arajā, अपि also, रुदन्ती weeping, सा she, आश्रमस्य of the hermitage, अविदूरतः not far from, प्रतीक्षन्ति she waited for, सुसंत्रस्ता greatly terrified, पितरम् father, देवसन्निभम् god-like.

40022588.author: Translation
40022588.content: Arajā, greatly terrified and weeping, waited for her god-like father not far from the hermitage. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 80 ।। Thus ends the eightieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
